research_scope: Original Sinbad six non-Home Voyage cards: eligibility for BOOST payment; Voyage Home maneuver timing. No summary edit and no later changed rule imported.

conclusion.supported_rule: The six Voyage cards without a printed BOOST value cannot be discarded as the payment for BOOST. A missing BOOST value is not BOOST 0 or BOOST 1. Voyage Home has printed BOOST 1 and is the exception.
conclusion.basis: The original action sheet establishes which six cards lack printed BOOST values and that Voyage Home has B1. Original core p10 defines discarding the card and adding its BOOST value. Justin Jacobson explains that omitted BOOST values intentionally keep Sinbad from dumping Voyage cards; this rationale would be defeated by treating a missing value as zero and permitting the payment.
conclusion.timing_inference: On a maneuver, discard Voyage Home to BOOST before moving. Its printed B1 adds one to movement. It is now in the discard pile, so Sinbad’s character ability counts it, adding another one to each own fighter’s maneuver allowance. With no prior Voyages, each own fighter may move up to 4 (base2 + BOOST1 + one Voyage1).
conclusion.timing_authority_boundary: This is an inference from the original core BOOST/discard operation and original always-applicable count of Voyages in the discard pile. Secondary FAQs explicitly agree, but the linked Discord author/message was inaccessible, so no separately verified publisher/designer timing quotation is claimed.
conclusion.no_later_rule_changes: Only original BoL1 card/character facts and original-system clarification from 2019 were used for the payment conclusion. Later publications were used only to corroborate identity, never to change gameplay.
